text:
oliver: FYI seeing host CPU tail on streaming pool after microbatcher shape tweak. p95 CPU +13% on ingest nodes. anyone on this?
mina: yep, alert fired. looks correlated with long lived streams with many small chunks.
pat: did kernel picker change recently?
oliver: no kernel changes. only microbatcher shape rolled last night to favor logical-boundary coalescing.
perf-bot: flame snippet from one host:
parse_assemble        30.6%
kvcache_lookup        14.2%
tokenize_stream       15.0%
http2_read             9.6%
small_syscalls         6.1%
others                24.5%

mina: tokenize_stream and small_syscalls are suspicious. suggests more parse work + more small reads (http2/hpack).
pat: KV metrics from same host show kvcache hit-rate fell 98% -> 89% in the window. likely more unique prefixes.
oliver: hypothesis: microbatcher changed fragment rhythm -> more micro-fragments -> lower prefix reuse -> repeated normalize/tokenize.
mina: repro harness available:
```
./stream-hammer --model=micro --clients=10 --msg-avg=200 --fragment-mean=90 --duration=3m
```
pat: tried repro locally, reproduces flame. canary attempt ideas: 1) rollback microbatcher for streaming pool 2) bump kvcache prefix TTL to 300ms on a canary 3) enable experimental writev read coalescing on a canary.
oliver: quick canary: bumped prefix TTL to 300ms on canary hosts. will monitor.
sre-bot: Applied change: kvcache.prefix_ttl=300ms to streaming-canary-1/8
perf-bot: canary metrics 5m later: host CPU -7% and kvcache hit 95% on canary.
mina: good signal that prefix reuse is part of problem.
pat: still want rollback if full pool remains high. also suggest adding ascii fast-path in tokenizer to skip utf8-normalize for ASCII-only payloads. cheap win for chat.
oliver: also let's add telemetry: fragment-size histogram, prefix reuse ratio, small-read syscall rate per host, and a tracer tag when microbatcher picks logical mode.
mina: agreed. pat, can you open PR for tokenizer ascii fast-path? add unit tests.
pat: yes PR incoming: tokenizer/fastpath-skip-normalize-if-ascii.
oliver: deployment plan: keep TTL bump on canary, queue rollback for streaming pool if CPU doesn't improve in 30m. add experiment matrix before future microbatcher rollouts.
mina: I'll keep kvcache telemetry for 24h and collect full flamegraphs for any remaining nodes.
pat: adding tracer tag on microbatcher as well so traces filter easily.
oliver: thanks team. small wins and good telemetry will prevent this class of regressions. :thumbsup:
